title: Welcome to Fog City
disclosure: Machine-generated fictional narration using Supertonic 3 stock voice M1. No real person is portrayed.

lines.text: San Francisco, five years from now. The hills are still steep. The fog still rolls in. And most of the robots are just trying to do their jobs.
You have a small company, a car, and eighteen months of runway. Today, the city has a different problem.
Moat Labs pushed a corrupted update. Some robots now grab, chase, and force that update onto others. A warning diamond marks a confirmed hostile robot.
Your water blaster rusts hostile robots until they seize and collapse. Watch their attack wind-up, keep your distance, and leave people, animals, and helpful robots alone.
Drive the hills. Take a bounty. Explore a landmark. Or start a timed taxi shift. Your phone holds the map, your bank, and graphics and audio settings.
Start at the Ferry Building plaza on the Embarcadero. Your cofounder has a first job for you, and a desk waiting in the Financial District. Probably.
